name: Barber Shop Uncut
review:
Barber Shop Uncut is a 40-line slot set in Monsieur Stache's old-school barbershop. Winning symbols lock in place and trigger respins, and the bonus offers free spins.

Thunderkick rates it Medium volatility, with a 2,355x cap and a strong 97.0% RTP. A charming, well-balanced game.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
